prior_tools_assessment.summary: Assessment of repository tools for mathematical extraction, region detection, and spatial preservation before and after the representation recovery milestone.

tools_evaluated.methods_used: OpenCV morphological dilation (3x3 kernel) + connectedComponentsWithStats; fixed aspect ratio thresholds (h >= 60 px, w >= 10 px for tall symbols; w >= 10*lh for wide regions)
tools_evaluated.failure_mode: Produced 0 candidates on typeset text-layer math equations (GS-001..005) because glyphs lack extreme aspect ratios; produced 15 false-positive candidates on astrophysics plot panels (2009.00031 p5) leading to OCR hallucinations
tools_evaluated.verdict: Obsolete for text-layer math; retained strictly as negative-control test fixture generator

tools_evaluated.methods_used: PyMuPDF page.get_text('blocks') and get_text('words') + K-Means color quantization + Tesseract OCR
tools_evaluated.failure_mode: get_text('words') discards font names, font sizes, and character origins; get_text('blocks') clumps prose and equations together; Tesseract destroys subscript/superscript relationships
tools_evaluated.verdict: Lossy at Level 1; replaced by rawdict character extraction

tools_evaluated.methods_used: Flat union-find clustering over baseline and multiline gaps + single-level prose rejection (span_count > 25)
tools_evaluated.failure_mode: Multiline gap tolerance bridged equations (1), (2), and (3) into a single 47-span mega-cluster, which was then rejected en bloc by the prose filter, causing 0.0 coverage on GS-005

tools_evaluated.methods_used: Unicode-only character regex (GREEK, MATH, MATH_PUNCT) on rawdict spans
tools_evaluated.failure_mode: Font-blind: discarded TeX CMEX10 'Z' (integral operator), MSBM10 'E' (blackboard bold expectation), and CMMI variables because ASCII letters were not in Unicode math tables
